about: A writer must send a welcome message of at most 300 characters. A length guardrail checks it and, if it is too long, sends it back to be shortened.
how: The guardrail has the action repair: the agent gets the problem and one more try.
learns: A guardrail can ask the agent to repair its own answer instead of stopping the run.
watch: The first answer is too long and fails the check; the second is short enough and passes.
